implementation: GPU singleton-pair distances computed in edge chunks; stable CPU ordering and connected union-find. Raw features and the frozen first GCN linear transform are separate controls. No labels or explanation outcomes enter the scores. Existing defaults remain unchanged.
compression: All five variants have the same global cluster count within each dataset. Query-local cluster counts differ, so these are not equal-local-compression comparisons.
finding: Raw-feature ranking reduces the measured raw feature projection residual relative to diffusion in both runs, but does not consistently improve prediction errors or decisions. First-linear ranking likewise gives no consistent fidelity advantage. This is evidence against promoting these fixed rankings, not a general impossibility result for feature-aware clustering.
timing: All approximate variants remain slower than the exact singleton/operator-reuse implementation in the measured serial forward workload. Shared GPU, four alternating repetitions, no gradients, batching or full-search timing. Ratios are baseline time divided by variant time; below one means the variant is slower.
verification: All exact controls pass saved/full/local numerical and binary comparisons. Source hashes, equal global cluster counts, raw error arithmetic, decision mismatches, timing positivity and alternating order independently checked after both runs.
interpretation_limits: These are the same previously inspected development queries. Static singleton-edge scores are not dynamic cluster-merge losses, and connected single-link-style unions can accumulate large within-cluster variation. Neither a lower feature residual alone nor fewer nodes certifies decision agreement.
next_method_question: If continuing approximate inference, use an explicit aggregate cluster-loss constraint or query-dependent refinement and evaluate the resulting accuracy/compression tradeoff. Merely changing fixed edge-ranking signals has not solved the observed problem. Coarse-guided support search remains a separate method whose independent value is still unverified.
manuscript: No LaTeX source, empirical values, tables or figures changed in this study. All outcomes are retained in JSON.
